findings: The advisory is current and real: CVE.org reports CVE-2026-48506 state PUBLISHED, and the live GHSA has withdrawn_at=null.

Primary incorrectly rejects 47e0c50 because FixArray/FixMap used ReadNext1. That does not close the gate: valid nested Array16/Map16 values already recurse through ReadNextArray/ReadNextMap, so uncontrolled recursive skip existed before ReadNextBlock.

62700694 broadens the flawed traversal to every array/map encoding through ReadNextBlock, 14b8fa59 later wires ReadNextBlock into formatter skip sites, and 91efb454 replaces the old reader with recursively implemented MessagePackReader.Skip; these are lifecycle expansions/replacements, not the first writer.
The primary final verdict NOT_AI and both release-line direct fixes are supported, but the introducer identity and origin narrative require correction.

corrected_fields.flaw_origin: The first public unbounded recursive skip writer is 47e0c50fb8820b0619194b97c0be35dbf6a4118d: MessagePackBinary.ReadNext dispatches Array16/Array32 and Map16/Map32 to ReadNextArray/ReadNextMap, whose child loops recursively invoke ReadNext with no depth accounting. Its parent lacks this API and decoder graph. Commit 62700694 later adds ReadNextBlock, extending complete recursive traversal to FixArray/FixMap; 14b8fa59 connects that API to formatter unknown-value skips; 91efb454 is the later MessagePackReader replacement.
